findings: ROOT CAUSE: engine.camera({pos,look}) wrote c.pos/c.pivot/c.fov but never c.yaw/c.pitch. projectNDC()/project() (sim/camera.js) build the view basis from c.yaw/c.pitch ALONE via viewBasis()/basisAt(), never from c.pos/c.pivot directly. stepCamera() already solves c.yaw/c.pitch correctly from an installed override via a (previously private) function applyOverride(c) -- but only once a fixed step runs. A caller that poses the camera and reads projectPoint() back off a DRAW (renderFrame(), or a tools/capture/ shot) rather than a STEP never ran that step, so c.yaw/c.pitch held whatever the follow rig had solved BEFORE the override -- plausible, structurally wrong.

FIX: exported applyOverride from sim/camera.js and had engine.camera() call it directly in place of its own 3-field copy. Not a second, divergable derivation of yaw/pitch -- the same function stepCamera() already calls every frame an override is installed, called one step early.

FALSIFIED + DELETE-THE-FIX (RULES 4/6): tools/camera/cam-projectpoint-fix.mjs, bare Node against the unmodified sim/camera.js. Fixed arm: 4/4 bearings on_screen:true, 4 distinct solved yaws. Pre-fix arm (old engine.camera() body, kept only as a copy for this one probe per RULES 17): yaw pinned at a single stale value on all 4 bearings, on_screen:true on exactly 1 of 4 -- reproducing the verdict's own description ('on the one bearing where the stale yaw happened to be nearly right it agrees with the pixels'). Two falsifiers (a point behind the camera, a point 90 deg off-aim) both correctly report on_screen:false/in_front:false under the FIXED code, so the instrument can still fail.

BROWSER CONFIRMATION: tools/camera/cam-projectpoint-r3-shot.mjs, via the shared capture daemon (tools/capture/, RULES 20 -- no new browser launched; box was at 24-30 concurrent headless_shell / loadavg 11-24 on 4 cores throughout, RULES 21 observed).
